discussions.covers: the Tahoe basin, Truckee and Mt Rose
messages: * A potent winter storm continues to impact the region through Friday morning, bringing heavy Sierra snow, strong winds, and hazardous travel. * Strong winds will continue over Sierra ridges, with gusty winds across western Nevada valleys and northeast California. * A brief break in precipitation Friday afternoon through Saturday morning will be followed by another system arriving Saturday afternoon, with yet another system on Thanksgiving week.

discussions.name: Sacramento
discussions.covers: the west slope: Donner Summit, Highway 50, Kirkwood to Dodge Ridge
messages: Winter storm warning remains in effect for elevations above 4000 feet for the northern Sierra and southern Cascades until 4am Friday.
Flood Advisory until 445pm Friday for low lying areas along the Delta and vicinity, with coastal flooding potential from high tides.
Weaker storm system over the weekend, with minor snow accumulations and light rainfall.
Active weather continues into the Thanksgiving travel week.
